title: two-moons-ml: N-body simulations and a machine-learning surrogate for a hypothetical second moon of Earth
description: Code for simulating 12,000 hypothetical second moons of Earth with the real Sun, Earth and Moon (REBOUND, JPL Horizons DE440) and for training and evaluating a Random Forest surrogate that predicts their fate from the initial orbital elements. Includes the configurations, manifests, committed test-set results, the paper source and its compiled PDF. The simulation data are archived as a separate dataset record.
